title: Pete Johnson visits; staying in Chicago and playing a club under the El
summary: Louella persuaded them to stay in Chicago and found them a job at Johnny's Place, with a naked woman painted on the window.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x:
So I told him, "Come on over an' see my new house."
"That ain't nome o' your house."
I say, "That what the man say." I say, "I put my name on it.
My wife got her name on it."
He was jealous: "You a lucky dude. You is lucky. You sumpin'
else!"
I said, "Well, you're now lookin' at a married man." Say,
"Ever'thing is just fine...while I'm in town."
He says, "We goin' back on the road?"
I say, "Yeahhhh." I say, "They ain't nothin' changed." I say,
"We goin' back on the road."
So we get us another gig. So we was off about a month. So
Pete Johnson come over to the house for dinner, brought his wife, an'
we started talkin' 'bout goin' back to Kansas City for awhile.
So my wife says, "You need to go back to no Kansas City."
Say, "You can work outa here just as easy as you can work outa Kansas
City. Chicago a bigger city than Kansas City." She say, "They got more
nightclubs here than any place in the world outside o' New York's the
only place..." Say, "I know every nightclub in this town, almost. I
know the people."
I say, "Well, okay, we'll stick around."
So she took...go with 'em each one o' her bosses, so Pete
Johnson got up and played, and I sang, sat down and had a few drinks
with the boss.
The boss say, "Well, when d'y'all wanna start?"
Say, "Well, I'm changin' the show next Tuesday. What about startin' Tuesday?" Said, "On a weekend, ever'thing'll be straight."
So we started workin' in the nightclub over there up under the Els...the Els. They had more nightclubs over there than you could shake a stick at.

I don't remember the name of the joint. Johnny's Place...or sumpin'...Johnny's Hall. Had a big naked woman painted on the front...on a window. So we started workin' there. We stayed there about two months. Then we got a offer to go back to New York City.
